0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The waiting pixie is sick and tired of waiting.

25.original: With the chat mode in <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Say<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, enter “Beaver” to let the hiding pixie know that the game is up.

48.original: Grrr, I am so angry right now! My friends promised that we'd play together here, but not one of them have come!

49.original: Instead they're over in Anden's Airs, playing hide-and-seek! That's the only game they ever play, hmph!

50.original: I want you to march over there and give them a good scolding for me! You're respected in our village, so they'll take your words to heart!

51.original: The others are over in Anden's Airs, playing hide-and-seek! Go over there and give them a good scolding for me!

52.original: ...A promise? I don't recall a─<hex:02100103>Ahhh! We completely forgot! Oh, we're so sorry!

53.original: We would go with you right now, but we're in the midst of a game of hide-and-seek. One of us is still hiding, and we can't well leave them behind. Will you help us search?

54.original: Thank you! Now, when you find them, you must say the word “beaver.” It's the rules!

56.original: Our last hiding friend should be somewhere nearby. Remember, when you find them, you must say the word “beaver.” It's the rules!

58.original: With the chat mode in <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Say<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, use your keyboard or the software keyboard to enter “Beaver” to let the hiding pixie know that the game is up.

59.original: (Shhh! Can't you see I'm trying to hide!?)

60.original: Oh no, I am found!<hex:02100103>...Wait, aren't you <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!? I didn't know you were playing too! This makes it even more fun, tee hee!

61.original: Tee hee, it was so fun being found by you! You must play hide-and-seek with us again!

62.original: You did well to find our hiding friend! We would never have thought to look there!

63.original: But come, it wouldn't do to keep our waiting friend waiting any longer. They aren't the most patient of pixies.

64.original: The others finally came, thanks to you! But what's this I hear about you playing hide-and-seek with them?

65.original: That's not fair! I want to be found by you too! Promise me you'll play with us again soon!
